description: This file defines a React component named TreeView that renders a nested, expandable, and searchable tree view for JSON data structures. It includes features like auto-expanding search matches, expand/collapse controls, and custom rendering of primitive values with truncation and highlighting.

methods.name: escapeRegExp
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for use in a regular expression.

methods.name: toDisplayString
methods.description: Converts a value to a string suitable for display, handling null, strings, numbers, booleans, and objects.

methods.name: shouldTruncate
methods.description: Determines if a string or value should be truncated based on length.

methods.name: truncateIfNeeded
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights parts of text matching a regex by wrapping them in a span with a specific class.

methods.name: addAncestors
methods.description: Adds all ancestor paths of a given path to a set, used for auto-expanding search matches.
